memories.content: The pilot team is awaiting the executive team's decision on the balcony-panel pilot. They are not part of the decision-making process.

Veldt Solar's quarterly review is scheduled for 2026-10-05. The balcony-panel pilot sold 400 units against a 1,000-unit target with strong reviews but thin margins. The head of product champions it, the CFO wants those engineers on the utility-scale line, and the CEO has stayed publicly neutral. The executive team will decide whether to formally shelve or greenlight the pilot, and if a decision is made, it will be communicated to the pilot team the same week.
